selections.rationale: One bounded test-only correction; preserve r4 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Construct a one-article queue with maxPage equal to native MaxInt; request after that article with Limit=ScanBudget=MaxInt. Require successful empty page, empty NextCursor and trace queue.next with zero counts. With two articles and cursor at the first, the same logical limits return only the second with correct trace. These are tiny physical inputs; do not create huge arrays. Remove nonnil-empty-Items assertions in both empty queue and exhausted cursor tests: assert length zero and required trace/cursor only. Preserve deterministic priority/key ordering, input/result isolation, budget/invalid/cursor errors and exactly zero PageResult on errors.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r4 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Use a tiny arena such as capacity=4/sharedLimit=4. Take(1), append nonzero bytes through that returned slice, then Take(1); the newly returned byte must initially be zero. Separately take adjacent live regions, append through the earlier result and verify the later live region remains unchanged. Assert behavioral isolation rather than a specific slice capacity. Keep shared exact fit, Used accounting, zero-size nonnil slice, independent fallback results and reset clearing/reuse. Do not promise independence from old shared slices after reset or allocate enormous arenas.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r4 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. For the same nonempty workload name, compare blueprint labels {desired: empty string} with current labels {existing: empty string}: require action update and exact desired labels. Matching keys with empty values require none; nil/empty maps compare equal. Retain create/delete/update/no-op, invalid blueprint, deletion priority, and caller map/condition isolation tests. Do not add current-state validation or require unspecified secondary return values on errors.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r4 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Define a test receiver with an exported variadic method taking a leading int and trailing ...string; invoke using exactly the declared argument count, with the final argument a []string, and check deterministic returned values. Include nil slice and untyped nil for that final slice, and reject expanded scalar arguments via type/count checks. Define a separate method taking unsafe.Pointer and returning whether it is nil; pass nil without any dereference. Retain bound method signatures, exported-only name lookup, exact assignability rather than convertibility, typed nil receiver rejection, zero-result nonnil slice, ordered multiple results and panic recovery with prior mutation retained. Do not introduce unsafe memory access or expanded-varargs acceptance.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r4 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. For an absent key, Get with scalar, typed nil pointer and nil interface destinations must return an error; do not constrain the boolean accompanying invalid-destination errors, on present or absent keys. A valid destination pointer on absent key must remain unchanged and return false,nil, without invoking user unmarshalling. For existing data and a valid nonnil pointer of incompatible decode type, require true,error. Keep encode-failure atomicity, input/result isolation, sorted Keys, Has/Delete and invalid-key rules. Remove nonnil-empty-Keys expectations: length zero suffices. Add bounded concurrent Put/Get/Has/Keys/Delete. Give each writer a distinct key and local destination; its ordered put, get, has, delete, absent-get, final-put has deterministic per-key assertions because no other writer changes that key. Check decoded values equal what that writer stored and absent destination stays unchanged. Readers check Keys sorting/uniqueness, not changing sizes; after joining verify exact final keys and values. Use a start channel, bounded loops, WaitGroup and goroutine-safe error reporting; avoid t.Fatal inside workers, sleeps, shared destination races, or assumed interleavings. Actual -race verification is separate.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r4 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Use the native largest int as the logical attempts value with initialWeight=1 and an action that succeeds on its first invocation. Require exactly one callback, used=[1], nil error; this needs only tiny physical work and must not allocate or invoke the full logical limit in the test. Retain bounded exhaustion and final error identity, immediate success, maxInt/2 saturation boundary, invalid input no-call/nil-used rule and unchanged propagated panic.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r4 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Create an existing note, choose a positive absent ID, and test DeleteMany containing existing, absent and zero IDs together in multiple orders; ErrInvalidNote takes precedence and no existing note is deleted. Include negative-ID variants, all-positive missing batch returning ErrNoteNotFound without partial deletion, duplicate deletion and empty success. Preserve ID accounting, byte-length/whitespace field limits, filtered ordering, pagination and detached values. Do not impose unspecified returned Note{} on error or invent Update field-versus-absence precedence.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r4 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Watch all namespaces. Insert namespace a\u0000b/name c and namespace a/name b\u0000c with distinct replica counts; both must survive sorted elementwise, and replacing/deleting one must leave the other intact. Embedded NUL is valid in nonempty identifiers; do not forbid or normalize it. Preserve watch parsing, validation/leadership/filtering, copy isolation and missing-delete handled=true. Add bounded concurrent Apply insert/replace/delete and Snapshot: each writer owns a distinct structural key and performs an ordered insert, replacement, deletion, final insert, checking every handled/error result. Readers check snapshots are sorted and contain no duplicate structural keys; do not assert changing counts or assume scheduling. After all goroutines join, assert exact final records and replica values. Use a common start channel, bounded loops, WaitGroup and t.Errorf or collected errors, never t.Fatal inside workers; no sleeps or unbounded retries. Do not race on test-owned shared slices. Actual race-detector qualification remains a separate sandbox step. Use an actual U+0000 character in runtime identifiers, not the literal backslash-u-zero-zero-zero-zero character sequence.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r4 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Use steps [a requires b, b, c] with all callbacks successful: require invocation/outcome order b,a,c. Include multiple newly ready earlier steps and independently derive the lowest original-index ready executable choice. Retain structural validation before any callback, input immutability, failure error text, independent continuation and transitive skipped statuses without invoking skipped callbacks. Remove any exact relative ordering assertion between skipped and executable outcomes, including claims that all dependencies must resolve before recording a skip: the specification does not settle that interleaving. Check those outcomes by name/status/error and separately check the executable callback order. Preserve explicitly nonnil empty successful plan.
